nc.description: A 3D rendering shows a mechanical assembly featuring a faceted central shaft, a surrounding ring with protruding tabs, and metallic bearings connecting to a cylindrical end cap.
Rough, faceted stones move along a conveyor belt into a mechanical device that shapes them into smooth, rounded cubes.
A light grey, angular bracket holds a silver cylindrical roller mounted on a white axle against a plain background.
A light grey sculptural object features a hinged arm positioned above a connected bowl filled with small white spheres.
Various light grey, geometric mechanical components are arranged flat on a white surface.

vc.description: A light gray power drill is attached to a mechanical assembly, twisting a thick white substance between two circular plates.
Cylindrical jars move along a conveyor belt through a monochromatic mechanical station equipped with exposed gears, a handle, and hanging straps with buckles.
A light grey hex bolt protrudes from the center of a textured grey component topped with a dark grey, U-shaped pad.
A grey mechanical device with a handle and lever is positioned above a tray containing small white objects.
Disassembled, light gray mechanical components are arranged on a plain white background.
